analysis.ratio_population: Reported median_ratio is the median of all paired-block ratios (six Mac or twelve Linux); confidence bounds instead use Linux physical hosts. Do not label the Linux twelve-block median as a six-host median.
analysis.score: Within each mirrored four-call block, use the geometric mean for each arm; excess = patch - base - max(0.05*base,0.001 seconds). Linux confidence units are the six physical-host medians of two block excesses; Mac units are six paired blocks. Exact order-statistic bounds use alpha=0.025 per tail. No simultaneous six-cell guarantee.

encoding.decode: base64-decode data, zlib-decompress, verify uncompressed_bytes and SHA256, then parse JSON. Calls archive contains seven runs and every ordered payload/timing; configurations contains normalized full plans, reports, preflights and provenance.
encoding.normalization: Raw argv is omitted from call rows and build summaries and replaced with its canonical-JSON SHA256. Absolute task/repository paths become logical URI labels; other personal/environment paths become SHA256 labels. Scientific/numeric values, signed zeros, timing integers, order and all original input-file hashes are retained. Normalized data cannot recreate original file bytes; original SHA256 bindings are distinct from decoded archive hashes.
encoding.privacy: No raw logs, raw command lines, personal absolute paths, credentials or data columns are embedded.

scientific_validation.actual_preflights: Sixteen science-only processes per platform, with twelve comparisons each, precede performance; exact summary hashes and all comparison results are retained in configurations.
scientific_validation.all_516_calls: Every payload science object exactly equals its actual preflight-derived plan reference, including signed zero. Native fingerprints, complete work and worker signatures remain exact; standalone non-timing fields match full-stream scientific preflight.
scientific_validation.independent_review: Independent read-only reconstruction verified all 516 schedules, scientific objects, interval coverage, child identities and paired scores. All seven result/plan/calls/observer bindings verified. All 156 Mac call logs, 52 native heads and 54 plan bindings verified; Linux individual call logs/heads were not collected locally and their recorded hashes are not presented as independently rehashed bytes.
scientific_validation.work_trace_scope: Every actual native performance call emits a solver trace. Standalone processes retain four measured solves after one four-solve internal warmup group.
scientific_validation.worker_scope: Fixed-worker exact repeatability and cross-worker science/discrete checks passed during preflight. Arithmetic-preserving arms match each worker reference exactly.
